integrity: Exact integer cofactor calculation and independent exhaustive Euler-circuit enumeration are reproducible using verification.py. Four counts cross-check exactly.
scientific_limitations: The exact census is restricted to binary cyclic de Bruijn sequences of order five and length-six palindromic factors, counted as distinct cyclic words modulo rotation.
No claim of an all-order distribution or of an independent audit is made.
The 2010-02-13 source date is an exact first public arXiv version date; an earlier 2006 print journal volume is known, without a day-level public-access date in the inspected record.
Novelty beyond the consulted primary literature has not been exhaustively established.
title: Exact length-six palindrome distribution in binary de Bruijn cycles of order five
